title: Getting to Know You — A1 to B2
description: Cuestionario diagnóstico de primera clase. Sube progresivamente del A1 al B2 mientras conoces al estudiante: información personal, preferencias, experiencias y expectativas.
topic: First-class diagnostic · A1 → B2 · Personal info, preferences, experiences, expectations

questions.question: What's your name and where are you from?
How old are you?
Where do you live now?
Do you work or do you study?
Do you live alone or with your family?
Do you have brothers or sisters?
What's your favorite food?
What kind of music do you listen to?
What do you like to do in your free time?
Why do you want to learn English?
What time do you usually wake up during the week?
What do you normally have for breakfast?
What did you do last weekend?
Tell me about your last vacation. Where did you go?
Tell me about your job or your studies. What do you do exactly?
What kind of movies or series do you enjoy watching?
How often do you exercise or play sports?
Who's the funniest person in your family? Why?
What's your favorite city in Chile, and why do you like it?
When did you start studying English? How long ago?
Have you ever traveled outside Chile? Tell me about it.
What's the most interesting place you've ever visited?
Have you ever tried a food that really surprised you — for better or worse?
What do you think about social media? Do you use it a lot?
Do you prefer working or studying from home, or in person? Why?
What are your main plans or goals for this year?
Are you planning any trips soon? Where would you like to go?
What do you like most, and what do you like least, about your current job or studies?
Which skill do you find most difficult: speaking, listening, reading, writing or grammar?
What are your goals for these English classes?
Would you rather live in a big city or in the countryside? Why?
Is it better to spend money on experiences or on things? Why do you think so?
If you had a completely free day tomorrow, how would you spend it?
Tell me about a book, movie, series or song that really impacted you. Why?
If you could learn any new skill this year, what would it be, and why?
How do you prefer to learn English — with grammar exercises, real conversations, games, videos, or reading?
What kind of topics would you like us to talk about in our classes?
Do you think technology has made us more connected as human beings, or actually more isolated? Why?
If you could change one thing about the education system in Chile, what would it be?
Where do you see yourself in five years — personally, professionally, and with your English?
Can you tell me about a decision that really changed the direction of your life?
What qualities do you think make a person truly successful in life?
If time and money weren't a problem, what would you dedicate your life to?
What's something most people believe that you personally disagree with — and why?
Why is it important for you specifically to reach an advanced level in English? What doors would that open?
